How status is worked out

Each EP gets one status, checked in this order: Refused if the Comments or Progress say REFUSED; Completed if a No Objection letter date is filled; Auth. Issue if the Comments start with AUTH. ISSUE or ON HOLD; Endorsed in principle if that date is filled; otherwise Received. A status picked by hand overrides this until you pick Automatic again. Picking Completed by hand also completes the EP's To-Do job. Closed and On Hold are only set by hand.
